marketing_description: The DeWALT DW0822CG Cross Line and Plumb Spot Laser features a self-leveling design and projects a green cross-line laser. This cordless tool has a working range of 100 ft without a detector and 165 ft with a detector, and includes an integrated magnetic pivoting base and overmolded housing for durability. It also comes with a 3 Year Limited Warranty and has an IP54 rating for water and debris resistance.
